lastResult.coverage: 截至北京时间 2026-09-16 11:54，多个公开 X 镜像与重置追踪源均将 9 月 12 日 08:09 UTC 的“Reset all propagated”列为最近一次已确认全局额度重置；9 月 15–16 日可见的 Tibo 新内容主要是产品发布/DevDay 级别 ships、Codex 功能讨论和非额度回复，未发现新的 reset、reset button、usage reset、tomorrow/soon 等明确重置排期。公开来源覆盖仍可能存在延迟或漏帖。
lastResult.summary: 补齐 9 月 11 日 occasional reset 暗示、9 月 12 日午夜前重置排期及 9 月 12 日完成确认；本轮当前时点未发现 9 月 12 日之后新的明确额度重置信号。

posts.text: Reset all propagated. Sweet dreams.
posts.translatedTextZh: 额度重置已全部传播完成。好梦。
reasons: Tibo 明确使用完成语义“Reset all propagated”，直接确认此前排期的全局额度重置已经传播完成。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo addressed Astra quality issues, described fixes, and said a reset was also landing by midnight that day.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 说明了 Astra 的若干质量问题与修复，并明确表示当天午夜前还会进行一次额度重置。
reasons: 原帖明确写出“a reset is also landing by midnight today”，属于直接且高强度的重置排期。

posts.text: When I say excellent service for existing users, that includes the occasional reset
posts.translatedTextZh: 当我说要为现有用户提供优秀服务时，其中也包括偶尔的额度重置。
reasons: 直接说明未来仍会有偶发额度重置，属于明确的政策/意向信号。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo announced that new subscriptions to the $200 Pro plan would be paused to protect the experience of current users and continued access to Astra.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 宣布将暂停新增的 200 美元 Pro 方案订阅，以保障现有用户的使用体验以及继续使用 Astra。
reasons: 容量约束已升级为实际暂停新增 Pro 订阅；属于近期再次全局额度重置的强下行信号。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said that everyone who used a banked reset during the affected time window would receive another banked reset and an apology email.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，在受影响时间段内使用过 Banked Reset 的所有用户都将再获得一次 Banked Reset，并收到一封道歉邮件。
reasons: 明确的补偿性 Banked Reset 发放信号。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said demand for Astra is unprecedented and that the team is pulling every available lever to sustain it.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，Astra 的需求前所未有，团队正在动用一切可用手段维持服务。
reasons: 反映明显容量压力。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo described request scheduling and routing optimizations that significantly reduce usage in long-running sessions.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 介绍了请求调度与路由优化，可在长时间运行会话中显著节省用量。
reasons: 用量效率改善属于下行信号。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said a post omitted that he had reset usage twice in the middle.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 回复称，对方漏掉了他曾在中途两次重置额度这一点。
reasons: 使用过去时明确确认曾执行额度重置。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said there is no schedule, only resets.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 回复称“没有排期，只有额度重置”。
reasons: 直接使用 reset 语境，但没有日期或承诺。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo confirmed that usage had been reset for everyone and wished users a good week with Astra.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 确认所有人的使用额度已经完成重置，并祝用户使用 Astra 度过愉快的一周。
reasons: 官方完成确认。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said OpenAI would perform a global usage reset for all paid subscriptions, expected around 6 p.m. Pacific time on September 7.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示将为所有付费订阅执行一次全局额度重置，预计在 9 月 7 日太平洋时间 18:00 左右到账。
reasons: 明确给出全局重置与时间窗口。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said Astra usage optimizations can reduce subscription usage draw by up to roughly 3–4 times in long-tail cases.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，Astra 的用量优化在长尾场景下最多可使订阅额度消耗降低约 3–4 倍。
reasons: 用量效率改善属于下行信号。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said Astra should be about 50% cheaper per task than Sol at roughly equivalent output.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，在输出大致相当时，Astra 每项任务的成本应比 Sol 低约 50%。
reasons: 额度效率说明，不是重置预告。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said there is no difference between the usage received before or after a reset.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，额度重置前后可获得的使用额度没有差别。
reasons: 澄清既有额度重置机制。

posts.text: Summary: Replying to a user discussing rapid Astra quota exhaustion, Tibo replied “150?”.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：一名用户讨论 Astra 快速耗尽额度时，Tibo 回复“150?”。
reasons: 语义不明确的额度相关弱信号。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said a full banked reset would be granted that day to all Plus, Pro, and Business users, landing by end of day.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，当天会为所有 Plus、Pro 和 Business 用户发放一次完整的 Banked Reset，并在当天结束前到账。
reasons: 明确的 Banked Reset 排期。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said Astra had rolled out to all Plus and Business users.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示 Astra 已向所有 Plus 和 Business 用户完成开放。
reasons: 结束此前等待 Astra 的主要补偿条件。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said some Plus and Business users without Astra access would receive a banked reset by end of day.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，部分尚未获得 Astra 的 Plus 和 Business 用户会在当天结束前获得一次 Banked Reset。
reasons: 明确的条件式 Banked Reset 排期。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said Astra rollout was progressing, with Pro and Business first and Plus expanding as quickly as possible.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示 Astra 正在推进分阶段开放，Pro 和 Business 优先，随后尽快扩大到 Plus。
reasons: 影响等待 Astra 的 Banked Reset 适用人群。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said Astra completed a task in 10–15 minutes and used less than 15% of the weekly Plus allowance.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示 Astra 完成该任务用时 10–15 分钟，消耗不到 Plus 每周使用额度的 15%。
reasons: 用量相关但没有重置承诺。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo replied “hahaha” to a user thanking him for the first Astra-related reset.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：一名用户感谢 Tibo 发放首个 Astra 相关额度重置，Tibo 回复“哈哈哈”。
reasons: 未明确确认 Banked Reset 已到账。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said paid ChatGPT plan users would receive one banked reset for every day they did not have Astra access.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，付费 ChatGPT 套餐用户每等待 Astra 访问权限一天，就会获得一次 Banked Reset。
reasons: 明确承诺条件式 Banked Reset。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said Astra would be included in each plan's normal usage allocation.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示 Astra 将计入各套餐的正常使用额度。
reasons: 正常额度说明，不是重置预告。

posts.text: Summary: Asked whether people were excited for Astra or the Codex reset, Tibo asked, “Which Codex reset?”
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：一名用户询问大家是在期待 Astra 还是 Codex 额度重置，Tibo 回问：“指的是哪一次 Codex 额度重置？”
reasons: 未承认明确的新重置安排。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo said he tries to pre-announce resets these days when he can.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 表示，如条件允许，他现在会尽量提前预告额度重置。
reasons: 与重置预告方式相关，但无日期。

posts.text: Tibo announced that Codex reached 25M active users and confirmed usage had now been reset for all paid ChatGPT Work and Codex subscriptions.
posts.translatedTextZh: Tibo 宣布 Codex 的活跃用户已达到 2500 万，并确认已为所有付费 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 订阅完成额度重置。
reasons: 明确使用完成时态并说明适用范围。

posts.text: Your Codex and ChatGPT Work reset will land at 6pm PST.
posts.translatedTextZh: 你的 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 额度重置将在太平洋时间下午 6 点生效。
reasons: 明确给出重置与具体时间。

posts.text: Summary: Tibo announced that usage was being reset for all paid Codex and ChatGPT Work users.
posts.translatedTextZh: 摘要：Tibo 宣布正在为所有付费 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 用户执行额度重置。
reasons: 明确表示正在为所有付费用户执行额度重置。
最近 72 小时没有发现 Tibo 新的 reset、reset button、usage reset、tomorrow、soon 或具体时间窗口等直接重置信号。
最近一次已确认全局额度重置为 2026-09-12 08:09 UTC；距离当前约 3.8 天。
公开追踪站当前主要给出约 24% 的未来 24 小时历史基线概率，但明确注明没有新的官方重置窗口。该概率仅为历史节奏推测，不代表 OpenAI 或 Tibo 的承诺。
